requirements.name: App renders JSX
requirements.description: The App component renders JSX instead of a plain string.
requirements.hint: Return a JSX element from the component, e.g. <main>...</main>.

requirements.name: App shows a heading
requirements.description: The App component renders a heading with the text "Greeting App".
requirements.hint:
Add

Greeting App

to the rendered output.

requirements.name: Typing updates the input
requirements.description: Typing into the #name input updates the controlled component state.

requirements.name: Submitting the form greets the user
requirements.description: Submitting the form after typing a name shows "Hello <name>".
requirements.hint: Handle onSubmit on the form and render the message in #message.

requirements.name: Clicking the counter increments it
requirements.description: Clicking the #counter button increments the displayed count.
requirements.hint: Keep count in state and update it in the button's onClick handler.

requirements.name: Users load on mount
requirements.description: The Users component fetches /api/users when it mounts and renders the returned names.
requirements.hint: Call fetch in a useEffect with an empty dependency array.

requirements.name: Fetch mock serves the right data
requirements.description: The mocked /api/users route returns the declared body.
requirements.hint: The fetch assertion mocks the declared routes; the component must fetch that URL.

requirements.name: Project depends on React

requirements.hint: Add react and react-dom to the dependencies in package.json.
